title: Student Performance Prediction System
summary: A Flask web application that predicts a student's final grade from academic and demographic features using a Random Forest model. To expand the small original dataset, new_dataset.py runs SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer to generate 5,000 synthetic student records used for model training.
evidence: new_dataset.py: model = GaussianCopulaSynthesizer(metadata); model.fit(df); synthetic_rows = model.sample(num_rows=5000)
